v.t: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

tm.nt: Shares a key word with, and is strongly linked by readers to, Eph 4:3 (46 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

title: A Song of degrees of David.
